text: Manali is a Himalayan town in Himachal Pradesh known for mountain scenery, rivers, forests and outdoor activities.
Incredible India lists Hadimba Temple, Vashisht Temple, Solang Nullah, Rohtang Pass, Brighu Lake, Naggar and Manali Gompa among Manali-area attractions.
The Incredible India guide lists Kullu-Manali Airport at Bhuntar and Chandigarh Airport, and Joginder Nagar Railway Station, as travel links for Manali.
General India travel guidance: respect local dress codes and customs, particularly at religious sites and in rural areas.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.
Shimla is a Himalayan hill town known for colonial architecture, mountain scenery, temples, churches and markets. It was once the summer capital of British India.
The Shimla guide highlights the Mall, the Ridge, Jakhu Hill, Viceregal Lodge and the Shimla-Kalka Railway.
Incredible India lists Shimla Airport and Shimla Railway Station. Its travel guide describes road access via Chandigarh and the Kalka-Shimla toy train from Kalka.
Incredible India's Shimla travel guide describes March to June as summer, July to October as monsoon, and November to February as winter; it notes snowfall can occur in December.
The Shimla guide names sidku, chana madra and patande among local foods, and also mentions momos and thukpa at local eateries.
